config.title: Where to Watch Football in Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: Practical answers for finding the right Berlin sports bar for your exact fixture, not just the league name.

items.q: What is the best sports bar in Berlin for football?
items.a: **Kilkenny at Hackescher Markt is the strongest all-round central choice in this guide.** Its official programme lists Premier League, Champions League, Europa League and Bundesliga football, it has multiple large screens and it takes online reservations. Belushi's Alexanderplatz is useful for a large English-speaking group, while Tante Käthe is the clearest verified non-smoking option. No bar is best for every fixture, so check the exact match before travelling.

items.q: Where can I watch Premier League matches in Berlin?
items.a: **Start with Kilkenny, Blarney, Belushi's Alexanderplatz, The Irish Pub at Uber Arena or Tante Käthe.** Their official pages describe Premier League or selected English-league coverage. That does not prove every simultaneous fixture will be shown. Open the venue's current programme or ask for your exact teams, the screen and the sound before you set out.

items.q: Where can I watch Champions League matches in Berlin?
items.a: **Kilkenny, Belushi's Alexanderplatz and The Irish Pub at Uber Arena explicitly advertise Champions League coverage.** Tante Käthe lists European football more generally, and FC Magnet's available calendar evidence was stale when this guide was checked. Tuesday and Wednesday can have several matches at once, so ask which screen will carry your fixture and whether it will have sound.

items.q: Can I reserve a table for a football match in Berlin?
items.a: **At some venues, yes, but the rule is not consistent.** Kilkenny, Belushi's Alexanderplatz and The Irish Pub at Uber Arena provide booking routes. FC Magnet says reservations are not possible during matches. Country Cheers states a 12 euro minimum spend per person for every football match. For a major fixture, book or confirm directly and arrive early even when you have a table.

items.q: Are football bars in Berlin smoke-free?
items.a: **Tante Käthe explicitly says it is non-smoking.** Country Cheers explicitly says it is a smoking pub, admits adults aged 18 and over, and has no normal food service. Smoking status was not clearly published for several other venues in this guide, so it remains unknown rather than being guessed. Ask the venue if smoke is a deciding factor.
